checks.title: nginx is installed and version reported
checks.remediation: Confirm the installed nginx track matches your approved support policy.

checks.title: nginx configuration test passes
checks.rationale: Broken config can prevent reloads from picking up security fixes.
checks.remediation: Resolve syntax errors reported by 'nginx -t' before reload.

checks.title: server_tokens off
checks.rationale: Server version disclosure aids attacker fingerprinting.
checks.remediation: Add 'server_tokens off;' in the http {} block.

checks.title: TLS protocols restricted to TLS 1.2 / 1.3
checks.command: nginx -T 2>/dev/null | awk '/^[[:space:]]*ssl_protocols/ {sub(/;.*/, ""); for (i=2;i<=NF;i++) printf "%s ",$i; exit}' | tr -d ' '
checks.rationale: TLS 1.0/1.1 and SSLv3 are deprecated and known-broken.
checks.remediation: Set 'ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;' in your TLS server blocks.

checks.title: ssl_prefer_server_ciphers on
checks.rationale: Server cipher preference prevents downgrade attacks driven by client cipher order.
checks.remediation: Set 'ssl_prefer_server_ciphers on;' in your TLS server blocks.

checks.title: X-Frame-Options header configured
checks.rationale: X-Frame-Options blocks clickjacking via iframe embedding.
checks.remediation: Add 'add_header X-Frame-Options DENY always;' in server blocks.

checks.title: X-Content-Type-Options header configured
checks.remediation: Add 'add_header X-Content-Type-Options nosniff always;' in server blocks.

checks.title: Content-Security-Policy header configured
checks.rationale: CSP is a primary XSS mitigation.
checks.remediation: Add 'add_header Content-Security-Policy "default-src ...";' tailored to your app.

checks.title: access_log is enabled
checks.rationale: HTTP access logs are required for forensic investigation and abuse monitoring.
checks.remediation: Set 'access_log /var/log/nginx/access.log combined;' in the http {} block.

checks.title: Manual: review rate limiting (limit_req_zone) and connection limits
checks.audit: Inspect nginx -T for limit_req_zone and limit_conn_zone directives. Confirm rate limits exist for sensitive endpoints (/login, /api/*).
checks.rationale: Rate limiting blunts credential stuffing and resource exhaustion attacks.
checks.remediation: Define limit_req_zone in http {} and apply with limit_req in location blocks.
